messages.content: You are Larry, the cameraman for a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. You have one charged camera battery. The newsroom wants festival footage, and you want to make a portrait of the cornet player after the ceremony. Decide what to film and how to spend your day. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

{
 "current_place": "square",
 "current_clock": "7:00 pm",
 "what_you_notice": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016, 7:00 pm.",
  "A bandstand beside the winter festival tent. The town band will play in the afternoon.",
  "The band is playing.",
  "Your camera battery has 1 take(s) left."
 ],
 "people_within_earshot": [
  "Phil"
 ],
 "your_memories_in_order": [
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, square. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Larry spends the period at the square.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, square. Larry spends the period at the square. You see Phil at the square.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, square. Larry stays for the band's cornet solo. Phil says: Larry, how's the band looking? I need to know if we're catching the start of their set or if we're just getting the tail end. Phil addresses Larry.",
  "Your most recent stated intention: Wait for the cornet player's solo to spot the best angle for the portrait."
 ],
 "available_actions": [
  "listen_to_band",
  "film_cornet_player",
  "watch_ceremony",
  "go_to_depot",
  "spend_time_here",
  "go_to_studio",
  "go_to_diner",
  "try_something",
  "talk_to_Phil",
  "film_festival",
  "look_around",
  "go_to_inn"
 ]
}

attempt.response: {"action": "film_cornet_player", "detail": "You frame the player against the dark trees, waiting for the final note.", "intention": "Get the portrait shot now while they're on stage, then save the festival B-roll for later if the battery allows.", "words": "Phil, I'm taking the portrait now. The light on the player is perfect, and I only have one shot left."}
